question: In which district of Maharashtra is Ralegan Siddhi, a small village that has become an example for watershed development, situated?
solution:
The Correct Answer is **__Ahmednagar__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **Ahmednagar** district of Maharashtra Ralegan Siddhi is situated.
 
• It is Located at a distance of at least** 87 kilometers** from Pune.
 
• It is also known as a model of environmental conservation.
 
• This village covers the area of **982.31 ha**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
